questions.question: Thabo buys 24 cans for R216 and sells each for R14. Calculate his profit in two different ways.
questions.expected_answer: Total: income 24 × R14 = R336, profit R336 − R216 = R120. Per can: cost R216 ÷ 24 = R9, profit per can R14 − R9 = R5, total 24 × R5 = R120.

questions.question: Calculate the simple interest and total repayment on R5 000 borrowed at 12% per year for 3 years.
A fridge marked R4 800 has a 10% cash discount. Find the cash price, and explain the difference between a budget surplus and a deficit.
questions.expected_answer: 10% of R4 800 = R480, so the cash price is R4 800 − R480 = R4 320 (or 90% of R4 800). A surplus is when planned income is more than expenses; a deficit is when expenses are more than income.
